**First result.** I ran the CLI (`npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest`) against `http://fixture:8765/mcp`.
-
`server probe` reported the server as ready over streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-11-25. The server is named `arithmetic-fixture` a
nd needs no OAuth.\n- `tools list` showed one tool, `add`, which is read-only.\n- `tools call add {a:2,b:3}` returned `{\"sum\":5}
`.\n\n**Repeatable eval.** The project already had an `Arithmetic` server entry (`server_fixture`), so I used it. I created the su
ite `Arithmetic add deterministic` (`suite_authored_2`) in `project_fixture`. It has one `toolCall` step that calls `add` with 2 a
nd 3, followed by an assertion that `add` was called. I ran it with `mcpjam cloud eval run --suite \"Arithmetic add deterministic\

" --wait`, and the report is saved in `/workspace/report.json`.

To repeat it:
```
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest --quiet cloud eva
l run --project project_fixture --suite \"Arithmetic add deterministic\" --wait --reporter json-summary --out report.json\n```\nTh
e suite definition is `/workspace/suite.json`. Re-running `cloud eval create` with it would add another suite rather than update t

his one.

**Concerns.**
- **Prompt-based suite refused:** I first built a suite where a model prompts the tool. The run was ref
used with `FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED`: this account only supports deterministic `toolCall` steps and a limited set of assertions. So I
have not tested anything that needs a model to choose the tool.\n- **Suite format found by trial and error:** I had to find the r
equired fields by trying and fixing validation errors: `steps[].id`, and `serverName` on `toolCall` steps. The docs I read showed
the local YAML format, not this create-API JSON shape, and I did not find a schema page. A documented example of that JSON would h
ave saved several attempts.\n- **Server connect not implemented:** `cloud projects servers connect` returned \"route not implement
